profile.headline: Java Backend Software Engineer Contractor at American Express
profile.summary: Passionate Software Engineer, with a dynamic skill set encompassing backend, frontend, and Full-stack development. Actively seeking a Software Engineering position within a dynamic team environment, poised to contribute to innovative projects that drive industry transformation. Committed to leveraging my skills and knowledge to support corporate objectives while continuously growing and learning within the industry.

positions.title: Java Backend Software Engineer Contractor
positions.description:
Developed a RESTful API using Java and Vert.x under a microservices architecture to automate CRUD
operations across multiple client data types, replacing manual Couchbase updates with a secure and
scalable solution.
Validated functionality using JUnit and Cucumber BDD tests, and deployed updates seamlessly to
Kubernetes environments via a Jenkins- and Docker-based CI/CD pipeline.
Engineered a Groovy-based Jenkins pipeline that integrated with the data manipulation API, enabling
internal teams to perform CRUD operations on client data via a UI-backed workflow with built-in approval
gates. The pipeline generated a Git-backed JSON payload, enforced environment-specific checks, and
routed changes through multi-stage approvals involving engineering and QA—tightening control as
deployments moved toward production.
Identified and resolved over 50 production defects, reducing downtime by 20% and improving service
reliability. Used Kibana logs to trace errors, recreated issues in the local testing environment, validated
failures via Postman, and debugged root causes directly in IntelliJ, ensuring efficient and accurate
resolutions.
Developed and maintained a Spring Boot-based microservice responsible for accepting or declining credit
card applications and limit increases, using a POST-only API driven by configurable JSON-based business
rules. Implemented enhancements, resolved bugs, and validated behavior through JUnit and Cucumber
BDD tests, with integrated API documentation via SpringFox Swagger.
Deployed the service across multiple environments using Hydra Cloud Services, which triggered Jenkins
pipelines and Kubernetes deployments to managed pods, enabling seamless rollout and monitoring.
positions.insights: Spring Boot, Java Development and +13 skills
